name: stitch-up-media
description: Minimalist macOS media encoder & stitcher powered by FFmpeg
author: Nitai Das <kiddow.san@gmail.com>

scripts.measure: npm run build && esbuild src/lib/filmstrip.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.filmstrip.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/lib/sourceFit.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.sourceFit.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/lib/timelineScale.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.timelineScale.cjs --log-level=warning && electron scripts/measure-layout.cjs
scripts.check-monitor: esbuild electron/mediaRange.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.mediaRange.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild scripts/monitor-repro.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=scripts/.monitor-repro.js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --log-level=warning && electron scripts/check-monitor-playback.cjs
scripts.check-tail: esbuild electron/ffmpeg/engine.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.engine.cjs --log-level=error && esbuild electron/ffmpeg/probe.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.probe.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/lib/visualization.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.visualization.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/check-audio-tail.cjs
scripts.verify-fit: npm run build && esbuild src/lib/sourceFit.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.sourceFit.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/lib/clipSpeed.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.clipSpeed.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/check-fit-chain.cjs
scripts.verify-codecs: esbuild electron/ffmpeg/engine.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.engine.cjs --log-level=error && esbuild src/lib/codecChoices.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.codecChoices.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/check-codec-choices.cjs
scripts.verify-wave: npm run build && esbuild src/lib/waveform.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.waveform.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/check-waveform.cjs
scripts.check-sync: swiftc -D QUICKLOOK_SCALE_HARNESS electron/quicklook-preview.swift electron/quicklook-scale.swift scripts/check-quicklook-sync.swift -o scripts/.check-sync -framework AppKit -framework AVKit -framework AVFoundation && scripts/.check-sync
scripts.icon: xcrun actool --output-format human-readable-text --notices --warnings --platform macosx --minimum-deployment-target 27.0 --target-device mac --app-icon AppIcon --output-partial-info-plist /tmp/stitchup-appicon-partial.plist --compile build build/AppIcon.icon
